source.title: CDC STEADI — Check for Safety (2017)
source.applicability: General US prevention guidance, plain-language summaries; not Italian building law or individual clinical advice.

entries.question: a rug on the visible floor
entries.action: Check that the rug is secured; consider removing it or adding a non-slip backing.

entries.question: a cable crossing the visible walking area
entries.action: Route cables along the wall and keep the walkway clear.

entries.question: objects obstructing the visible walking area
entries.action: Clear objects from the walkway and check the passage in person.

entries.question: a night light on the visible bedroom to bathroom route
entries.action: Check the route’s lighting at night and consider a night light.

entries.question: a support grab bar beside a visible toilet or bath
entries.action: Check with a professional whether bathroom supports are needed and how to install them.

entries.question: a handrail beside visible stairs
entries.action: Check with a professional that the handrails are stable and continuous.

entries.question: frequently used objects on a high shelf
entries.action: Move frequently used items within reach, so no one has to climb on chairs.

entries.question: any other visible feature that may warrant a home-safety review
entries.action: Ask the professional to check the item and the possible risk on site; a photograph alone cannot establish safety.
